mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_base (knowledge_base_name, description, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{knowledgeBaseName}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, knowledge_base_name, description, status, created_at, updated_at from knowledge_base where knowledge_base_name = #{knowledgeBaseName} limit 1

select id, knowledge_base_name, description, status, created_at, updated_at from knowledge_base
and knowledge_base_name like concat('%', #{knowledgeBaseName}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by id desc
